bugs.title: Review assurance guidance repeats degraded-r1 for three-local-rounds, making DONE evidence impossible to converge

evidence.symptom: review_escalation_status required three fresh single-host PASS rounds but emitted only the B-e256-degraded-r1 reviewer-host command; repeating it produced a duplicate verdict and reduced assurance from 1/3 to 0/3.
reproSteps: Read review_escalation_status for B-e256 and observe singleHostRounds required=3 with only degraded-r1 guidance.
Execute the sole reviewer-host degraded-r1 command and observe 1/3 valid rounds.
Read status again and observe the same degraded-r1 guidance.
Repeat that command and observe duplicate-round rejection with 0/3 valid rounds.
evidence.hypothesis: The guidance builder ignores current valid, invalid, and ignored single-host round identifiers when allocating commands.
evidence.rootCause: buildReviewAssuranceGuidance hard-coded one round whenever requireSingleHostPath was true and did not allocate the missing round numbers from singleHostRounds state.
evidence.fixEvidence: Commit af32b8a179 adds bounded missing-round allocation, skips every known run id, emits required-minus-valid commands, recovers from a poisoned r1 as r2/r3/r4, and emits no replay command after satisfaction. The 19-check review-assurance-floor smoke and both complete 132/132 validation runs pass.
